details: The agent faithfully executed the planned analysis in analysis_info.json. They ran the provided Python script to compute skewness/kurtosis, Mahalanobis outliers, and to fit both MixedLM (random intercept by village) and OLS models on the full dataset and on the dataset excluding the six pre-specified villages (70, 61, 60, 84, 59, 58). A minor, bounded code repair was applied to correct the village exclusion filter (string vs numeric comparison), which is within the allowed debugging scope. Final outputs in data/analysis_results.json match the reported execution_results.json, including coefficients, SEs, CIs, p-values, and sample sizes for both specifications and both model families. No major deviations from the planned path were observed.
